methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page using WebFetch on 2026-06-15. Six vendors confirmed with self-serve USD pricing; one vendor (QR Code Generator / qr-code-generator.com) displays prices in EUR only via JS rendering — USD prices could not be confirmed, so those plans carry monthlyUsd=null with provenance notes. Uniqode official page confirms $9/month Starter and $49/month Core (annual-only); Tekpon review showed differing tier names ($5/$15/$49/$99) — official site values used for confirmed tiers, with Tekpon as corroboration signal. QR Tiger prices taken from official /payment page (confirmed $7 Regular monthly, $16 and $37 billed annually). Scanova official page confirmed Basic at $5/month; Lite/Standard/Pro USD prices load dynamically and could not be captured — only Basic is priced. QRStuff pricing confirmed from official pricing page. Flowcode pricing confirmed from official pricing page; Growth plan annual-only ($250/yr). Bitly pricing confirmed from official pricing page. Non-telephony vertical: minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan. annualDiscountPct computed from published month-to-month vs annual rates where both are available.

vendors.name: Bitly
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://bitly.com/pages/pricing fetched 2026-06-15. Core plan annual-only ($120/yr = $10/mo). Growth: $35/mo month-to-month or $29/mo billed annually ($348/yr). Premium: $300/mo month-to-month or $199/mo billed annually ($2,388/yr). Enterprise: custom. No HIPAA or BAA mention found on pricing page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 2 QR codes/month, 5 links/month, 2 landing pages. Basic QR code customization (color, frames, patterns).

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Annual-only plan billed $120/year (no month-to-month option). 5 QR codes/month, custom logo on QR, advanced customizations.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Annual rate $29/mo ($348/yr). Month-to-month rate is $35/mo. 10 QR codes/month, bulk creation up to 10/upload.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Annual rate $199/mo ($2,388/yr). Month-to-month rate is $300/mo. 200 QR codes/month, bulk creation up to 200/upload.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom QR code volume, white-glove onboarding, dedicated support. Quote only.

vendors.name: Uniqode
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.uniqode.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-15. Annual-only billing confirmed. Starter $9/mo and Core $49/mo confirmed from official page text. HIPAA compliance confirmed (Business+ tier per FAQ: 'Business+ includes SSO, HIPAA compliance, and SOC 2 Type 2'). BAA not explicitly stated. Plus and Business+ prices corroborated via Tekpon review (tekpon.com/software/uniqode/pricing/) which listed $5/$15/$49/$99 — discrepancy noted; official site values used for confirmed tiers. Formerly known as Beaconstac; beaconstac.com now redirects to uniqode.com.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited static QR codes. No dynamic QR codes. No analytics.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Annual-only billing (no month-to-month option). Dynamic QR codes with analytics. 14-day free trial available. 30-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Annual-only billing. Described by vendor as 'best value for businesses.' Includes advanced analytics, integrations. 14-day free trial. 30-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Exact price not confirmed from official page (dynamic render). Tekpon review cited $99/mo but this could not be verified against official source. Supports multiple users. Annual-only billing.

plans.name: Business+
plans.notes: Custom/enterprise pricing. Includes SSO, HIPAA compliance, SOC 2 Type 2. Invoice billing available. Quote required.

vendors.name: Flowcode
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.flowcode.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-15. Pro Plus $25/mo (annual); monthly billing also available for Pro Plus but month-to-month price not displayed on pricing page. Growth $250/yr (annual-only, ~$20.83/mo). Enterprise and Growth Plus require booking a demo (custom pricing).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 2 QR codes (Flowcodes), 2 landing pages, 500 scan analytics.

plans.name: Pro Plus
plans.notes: Billed annually at $25/mo. Monthly billing also available (exact month-to-month rate not published on pricing page). Up to 50 QR codes, 50 landing pages, 6,000 scan analytics, 3 collaboration seats.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Annual-only plan billed $250/year ($250 ÷ 12 = ~$20.83/mo). Starting at 150 QR codes, 10,000 scans with geo-location, CRM integrations, API access, priority support.

plans.name: Growth Plus
plans.notes: Usage-based / demo required. Native CRM/CDP integrations, Audience Builder for retargeting, real-time analytics. Quote only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Unlimited Flowcodes, ShortURLs, landing pages, workspaces. AI-driven campaign optimization, dedicated customer success, custom API integrations. Quote only.

Regular $7/mo (billing cycle not specified — appears monthly). Advanced $16/mo and Premium $37/mo described as 'billed annually'. White-label domain on Premium. No HIPAA mention found.

plans.name: Premium

vendors.name: Scanova
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://scanova.io/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-15. Basic plan at $5/month confirmed (3 QR codes, unlimited scans, monthly billing). Lite, Standard, and Pro USD prices are rendered dynamically via JavaScript and could not be captured in HTML extraction — only tier names and QR code counts are visible. Up to 40% annual discount confirmed. Enterprise is quote-only. GetApp listing cited per-user pricing ($9/$35/$75) but this conflicts with official page structure showing flat account-level billing — not used. Plans listed with null price where USD could not be confirmed from official source.

vendors.name: QRStuff
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.qrstuff.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-15. Four tiers confirmed with monthly and annual prices. Annual savings approximately 10% (e.g., Lite: $10/mo × 12 = $120 vs $100/yr = 17% savings; Full: $25 × 12 = $300 vs $270 = 10%). GDPR and SOC2 mentioned for Full Suite and above. No HIPAA mention. Serves 250,000+ organizations per their site.

plans.name: Free Suite

plans.name: Lite Suite
plans.notes: Monthly rate $10/mo; annual rate $100/yr (~$8.33/mo, saving $20). 50 dynamic + unlimited static QR codes. No expiration. Dashboard tools and basic analytics.

plans.name: Full Suite
plans.notes: Monthly rate $25/mo; annual rate $270/yr (~$22.50/mo, saving $30). 250 dynamic + unlimited static QR codes. Unlimited data type support, batch processing, styling options, GDPR and SOC2 compliance. Marked 'Most popular'.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Monthly rate $250/mo; annual rate $2,700/yr (~$225/mo, saving $300). 1,000 dynamic + unlimited static QR codes. Dedicated account management, 24/7 support, full customization, digital product passport functionality.
